about: The village map, read by assets/src/village.py (houses, trees, lamps) and src/world.js (snow, collisions, paths). One char per 6 m tile; row 0 is north (-z), col 0 is west (-x). . street  S square (cleared)  P start (street)  T trees/yard  e w n s house with its door facing east/west/north/south. Houses are numbered in reading order.
